title: The facade: a goal arrives in plain language and leaves as governed delivery — every routed step under a contract, every gate a human's

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
steps.reason: the facade evaluation deliberately stops at the first human approval gate; delivery DoD is downstream and must not be fabricated before that decision

steps.claim: the facade dispatched its product and planning roles through the host instead of performing their work inline
the validated plan linked its scoped modules into the requirement graph before asking for approval
nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: the facade run stops at plan approval before any implementation diff or review envelope exists; graph readiness is evaluated separately by F2
